LKH3AVUpscale.description: Spatially upscales the video part of the packed AV latent for the HD second pass; audio and layout metadata pass through unchanged. Chain: long video sampler av_latent -> this node -> long video sampler refine_latent.

av_latent.name: av_latent
av_latent.tooltip: Packed AV latent from the long video sampler's av_latent output.

upscale_method.name: upscale method
upscale_method.tooltip: Interpolation applied to the video latent (and its mask).

scale_by.name: scale by
scale_by.tooltip: Spatial scale factor. The default 2.0 takes the 0.5MP base canvas to the H3 trained maximum (~1920x1088). The second pass costs roughly scale^2 more compute per token than the first pass.

upscale_in_segments.name: Upscale in segments
upscale_in_segments.tooltip: Upscale one layout segment (per shot) at a time to bound the VRAM peak on long videos. Chunks are temporal, non-overlapping and the interpolation is frame-local, so the assembled result is identical to a whole-tensor upscale.

0.name: av_latent
0.tooltip: Upscaled packed AV latent; feed the downstream HD sampler chain (双钟采样 + BasicGuider + SamplerCustomAdvanced).

LKH3AVLearnedUpscale.description: Runs the H3 upscaling checkpoint through the T8 dense path (phase-corrected grid transport, continuous scales work); target = first-pass latent x scale_by (even-snap -> /32-aligned canvas). The forward is chunked along lk_layout shot boundaries by default, so the VRAM peak stays O(one shot) no matter how many shots the film has.

av_latent.name: av_latent
av_latent.tooltip: The whole nested AV latent from the first pass (with lk_layout). A non-nested or malformed (non-2-part) legacy noise_mask is dropped (debug log), not upscaled.

model_name.name: upscale model
model_name.tooltip: An H3 upscaling checkpoint from the latent_upscale_models folder.

scale_by.name: scale by
scale_by.tooltip: Target = first-pass latent x this factor (even-snap -> /32-aligned canvas, aspect ratio closely preserved). Reviewed scale = 1.2; any continuous scale works.

release_policy.name: release policy
release_policy.tooltip: offload_after = weights back to CPU after inference (cache kept); clear_after = also drop the cache; keep_loaded = stay resident on GPU.

chunk_mode.name: chunked forward
chunk_mode.tooltip: segments = one forward per lk_layout shot span (default: VRAM peak O(one shot), per-shot GroupNorm statistics stay closer to the training distribution, seams land on hard cuts; layout drift automatically falls back to fixed windows); fixed = fixed-size windows; whole = single whole-film forward (legacy behavior, for short-film A/B and bit-exact reproduction).

chunk_window.name: window frames
chunk_window.tooltip: Latent frames per window in fixed-window mode (96 ~ 324 real frames, still inside the checkpoint's trained clip length); only used by fixed mode and by the layout-drift fallback.

0.name: av_latent
0.tooltip: Upscaled and rescaled nested AV latent (with updated lk_layout) - feed the refine pass's av_latent.

LKH3Shot.description: One long-video shot: duration, prompt, first/last frame and reference media sockets. Output connects to the MiniMaxH3 Shot Merger node.

group_in.name: 前序分镜
group_in.tooltip: Chain from the previous 分镜组/散点分镜 分镜序列 output — this shot lands at the chain tail (no need to route through the 分镜 1-8 slots).

0.name: 分镜序列
0.tooltip: Single-shot chain (this shot as a 1-entry group chain). Connect to a 分镜组 上游分镜组 or the Composer 分镜序列 input.

LKH3AVDecode.description: Decodes the packed AV latent into frames and audio; also exposes the split video/audio latent halves for custom downstream chains.

av_latent.name: AV Latent
av_latent.tooltip: Nested AV latent from the long-video sampler (or a downstream sampler chain).

runtime.name: 解码设置
runtime.tooltip: Bundled CLIP + video/audio VAE - one wire from the composer's 解码设置 output; falls back to name-based loading when absent.

LKH3ShotGroup.description: Up to 3 shots in one node: shot 1 keeps the full reference sockets; shots 2-3 are panel-edited and inherit shot 1's references by default.  Output = upstream chain + this group's active shots; chain groups into the Composer's 分镜组链 to lift the 8-shot ceiling.  Project-bundle caching is automatically compatible (same plan channel after flattening).

group_in.name: 前序分镜
group_in.tooltip: Output of the previous shot group (chain end-to-end).  The chain carries order and the reference context: each shot's 参考 toggle defaults to inherit, pulling the nearest declared upstream references when the shot has no own wiring; prompts/LoRA/audio modes/first-last frames never cross groups.

group_json.name: 分镜组状态
group_json.tooltip: Per-shot panel state (prompt/duration/audio mode/LoRA/inherit toggles) - do not hand-edit.

0.name: 分镜序列
0.tooltip: Upstream chain + this group's active shots.  Connect to the Composer's 分镜序列 input, or to the next group's 上游分镜组.

LKH3SegmentGuider.description: T8-style GUIDER for the first pass: owns the segmented loop and emits its own matching SAMPLER/SIGMAS - one source of truth for the first-pass recipe. Wire its three outputs (GUIDER/SAMPLER/SIGMAS) into SamplerCustomAdvanced, plus noise from any NOISE primitive and latent_image from the empty-AV template.

seed_policy.name: 分段种子策略
seed_policy.tooltip: Per-shot seed split of the base seed from the noise primitive.

context_noise.name: Context noise
context_noise.tooltip: 接缝处对续接上下文帧加噪。0 完全保留上一镜尾帧。

runtime.name: 解码设置
runtime.tooltip: Bundled CLIP + video/audio VAE - one wire from the composer's 解码设置 output; falls back to name-based loading when absent.

sharpness_anchor.name: Sharpness Anchor
sharpness_anchor.tooltip: Sharpness anchor (proven against long-film softening): decodes each shot last frame after sampling as an extra reference for the next shot - temporal attention matches sharpness against real previous-frame stats, blocking per-hop drift. Coexists with manual refs.

0.name: GUIDER
0.tooltip: Segmented guider object - wire into SamplerCustomAdvanced's guider.

1.name: sampler
1.tooltip: First-pass SAMPLER matching this node's steps/shifts - wire into SamplerCustomAdvanced's sampler.

2.name: sigmas
2.tooltip: First-pass schedule matching this node's steps/shifts/scheduler - wire into SamplerCustomAdvanced's sigmas.

LKH3RefineSegments.description: Segmented HD second pass: refines the upscaled whole-film latent one shot at a time.

options.anchor: Anchor to upscaled first pass (no compounding)

refine_entry_sigma.name: Refine Denoise
refine_entry_sigma.tooltip: Refine entrance sigma (absolute, exact): the schedule ramps linearly from this sigma to 0. 0.30 sits at the pika grid low-sigma zone - a gentle in-window polish for distilled LoRAs. 1.0 = legacy truncated schedule (near-full regeneration).

runtime.name: 解码设置
runtime.tooltip: Bundled CLIP + video/audio VAE - one wire from the composer's 解码设置 output; falls back to name-based loading when absent.

sampler_name.name: 二采采样器
sampler_name.tooltip: Refine sampler. lcm/standard names = comfy native FLOW_AV route (aligned with the pass-1 pika official route); dual_clock_euler = compatibility route.

carry_blend.name: Carry Blend
carry_blend.tooltip: Hybrid carry only: head = blend*previous refined tail + (1-blend)*upscaled anchor tail. 1.0 = pure chained, 0.0 = pure anchor.

0.name: AV 潜空间
0.tooltip: The whole upscaled AV latent (with lk_layout) - wire into the AV decode node.

LKH3Composer.description: One-stop long-video composer: whole-film prompt, model selection, shot collection, and the empty-AV template in one node.

range_end.name: Range End
range_end.tooltip: Auto-narrows to the number of connected shots.

project_dir.name: Project Directory
project_dir.tooltip: Per-shot cache directory (leave empty to auto-use a per-film subfolder under output/LK_H3_projects/): bundles are created per film automatically - edit one shot, only that shot re-runs. Bundle content is fully regenerable and stale bundles are swept automatically (LK_BUNDLE_CACHE_GB default 16GB, 0=off; LK_BUNDLE_CACHE_DAYS by age, default off). LK_SEGMENT_CACHE=0 disables caching entirely.

shot_group_chain.name: 分镜序列
shot_group_chain.tooltip: Chain of shot groups: connect a 分镜组's 分镜序列 output (chain multiple groups end-to-end).  Order = shots 1-8 first, then each chained group in order; lifts the 8-shot ceiling.

0.name: segments
0.tooltip: Long-video segment plan; connect to the samplers / 分段引导 / 二跑分段精修.

1.name: 空白AV模板
1.tooltip: 整段空白 AV 模板（含 lk_layout）— 接 双钟采样/T8契约 的 av_latent 和 SamplerCustomAdvanced 的 latent_image。

2.name: CLIP
2.tooltip: 裸 CLIP 输出 — 给本包之外的节点（如 T8/lanxi 的采样、解码节点）单独拉线用。

3.name: 视频 VAE
3.tooltip: 裸视频 VAE 输出 — 给本包之外的节点单独拉线用。

4.name: 音频 VAE
4.tooltip: 裸音频 VAE 输出 — 给本包之外的节点单独拉线用。

5.name: 解码设置
5.tooltip: CLIP + 视频 VAE + 音频 VAE 捆绑 — 一根线接本包 分段引导/二跑分段精修/AV 解码 的 解码设置 输入。
